item.title: LOVE PSYCHOLOGY 💞 The Tiny Habit of Couples Who Last (Gottman)
item.description: Couples who last answer each other's small bids for attention, so notice them and turn toward your partner.

item.title: SPOTLIGHT EFFECT 🔦 Nobody Notices You As Much As You Think
item.description: People notice your looks and slip-ups far less than you think, so you can worry less and try more.

item.title: How to Never Give Up: James Dyson's 5,127 Prototypes
item.description: James Dyson built 5,127 prototypes before one worked: every failure is data for the next try.

item.title: The Peak-End Rule: Why Endings Matter Most (Kahneman Study)
item.description: We remember experiences by their most intense moment and their ending, not by how long they lasted.

item.title: How to Change Your Life in 90 Days (Jay Shetty's Method)
item.description: Do less, make it fun, and plan if-then rules so new habits last.

item.title: Why You're Still Tired After Resting All Weekend
item.description: Rest from whatever actually drained you, not just from work in general.

item.title: Sharks Are Older Than Trees
item.description: Shark-like fish were swimming the oceans tens of millions of years before the first forests grew.

item.title: Turn Your Phone Gray to Scroll Less
item.description: Remove the color and your phone becomes less tempting to scroll.

item.title: NASA Lost a $125 Million Spacecraft Over Units
item.description: Small mismatches between teams can sink huge projects, so agree on units and definitions first.

item.title: The 5-Second Trick That Beats Procrastination
item.description: Count 5-4-3-2-1 and move before your brain talks you out of it.
